tool.help:
CellJourney - Interactive 3D Single-Cell Trajectory Explorer ============================================================
Purpose ------- CellJourney enables interactive exploration and analysis of single-cell trajectories in three-dimensional space. It provides tools for visualizing and analyzing biological datasets at both the dataset and individual cell levels.
For more information, visit the `CellJourney documentation <https://tabakalab.github.io/CellJourney/>`_.
Docker Image ------------ This tool requires building the CellJourney Docker image. To build it::
git clone https://github.com/TabakaLab/CellJourney.git cd CellJourney docker build -t galaxy/celljourney:0.1.0 .
Input Data ---------- CellJourney accepts single-cell datasets in the following formats:
- **H5AD**: HDF5-based AnnData format (recommended, used by Scanpy) - **CSV**: Comma-separated values with cell coordinates and metadata
The dataset should contain 3D embedding coordinates (e.g., from UMAP, PCA, or diffusion maps) for trajectory visualization.
Features -------- - **3D Scatter Plots**: Visualize cells in 3D embedding space - **Cone Plots**: Show velocity or directionality information - **Streamlines & Streamlets**: Visualize RNA velocity or trajectory flow - **Volume Plots**: Represent feature activity values in 3D embeddings - **Trajectory Analysis**: Interactive cell journey trajectory computation - **Differential Expression**: Automated differential gene expression analysis for calculated trajectories - **Export**: Save publication-ready figures as raster graphics, vector graphics, or standalone interactive HTML files
Outputs ------- When you stop the interactive environment, any exported figures will be available in the "CellJourney exported figures" output collection.
References ---------- - GitHub: https://github.com/TabakaLab/CellJourney - Documentation: https://tabakalab.github.io/CellJourney/
